question: A silver puja thali set marked at Rs. 10,000 is sold with two successive discounts of 10% and 5%. An additional 5% discount is offered if the payment is made in cash mode. Find the selling price of the article on cash payment.
solution:

Marked price (M.P) = Rs.10000

Discount (D₁) = 10% ; Discount (D₂​) = 5%

Additional discount (D₃) = 5%

**Formula used:**

Selling price (S.P) = M.P × (100 - D)%
